title: Solution Architect - Senior
jobDescription:
The Solution Architect - Senior is responsible for assessing, designing, and implementing scalable solution architectures aligned with Cummins enterprise architecture strategies, standards, and principles. This role defines application and solution designs for complex systems in partnership with product and project teams, ensuring technical solutions meet business, security, governance, and compliance requirements. The incumbent provides technical leadership in designing end-to-end analytics and AI architectures, including data pipelines, machine learning systems, and enterprise integrations. The role also drives innovation through proof-of-concepts (POCs), evaluates emerging technologies, and ensures architecture decisions create measurable business value.
  

  
Key Responsibilities
  

  
+ Design and own end-to-end scalable solution architectures for analytics, AI, cloud, and enterprise systems aligned with enterprise standards.
  
+ Define system component architecture, functional allocation, and interfaces between applications, platforms, and infrastructure components.
  
+ Develop multiple solution design options, perform cost-benefit analysis, and recommend optimized architectures based on business and technical requirements.
  
+ Create and maintain reference architectures, reusable design patterns, and architecture building blocks for global adoption.
  
+ Apply enterprise architecture standards, frameworks, styles, technology stacks, and patterns in solution development.
  
+ Drive architectural improvements and influence enterprise technical strategy through collaboration with Principal Solution Architects and engineering teams.
  
+ Architect scalable data pipelines, ML systems, and system integrations to support advanced analytics and AI use cases.
  
+ Analyze complex business processes, governance requirements, and technical constraints to create practical, scalable solutions.
  
+ Lead pilot programs and proof-of-concept initiatives to validate technology capabilities and support innovation.
  
+ Evaluate infrastructure capacity and recommend improvements to support current and future business needs.
  
+ Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to align technical solutions with strategic business goals.
  
+ Promote adoption of standard technologies and best practices through strong collaboration with customers, peers, and engineering teams.
  
+ Identify, assess, and manage architecture-related risks and issues while driving mitigation strategies.
  
+ Stay current on emerging technologies, software trends, architecture methodologies, and industry best practices.
  

  
**Skills**
  

  
+ Enterprise Architecture & Solution Design
  
+ Cloud Architecture (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
  
+ Data Architecture, Data Warehousing & ETL
  
+ Machine Learning Systems & MLOps
  
+ System Integration & API Architecture
  
+ Analytics and AI Platform Design
  
+ Architecture Frameworks & Reference Models
  
+ DevSecOps and Agile Delivery Practices
  
+ Risk and Issue Management
  
+ Stakeholder Management & Business Relationship Management
  
+ Cost Optimization and Performance Engineering
  
+ Technical Leadership and Strategic Thinking
  

  
**Technical Skills**
  

  
+ Strong proficiency in  **Python**  and  **SQL**
  
+ Experience with  **data modeling** ,  **ETL frameworks** , and  **data pipeline design**
  
+ Experience with  **machine learning lifecycle management (MLOps)**
  
+ Knowledge of  **build automation, version control, and CI/CD pipelines**
  
+ Understanding of  **security, governance, and compliance requirements**  in architecture design
  

  
**Experience**
  

  
+ Intermediate to advanced experience in solution architecture, enterprise systems, or a related technical discipline required.
  
+ Demonstrated experience designing architecture for  **cloud-based platforms and enterprise applications** .
  
+ Proven ability to architect complex technical solutions and translate business requirements into scalable technical designs.
  
+ Experience leading cross-functional technical teams and influencing architecture decisions across stakeholders.
  
+ Experience in:
  
+ Analyzing complex business systems and industry requirements
  
+ Designing scalable enterprise data and analytics solutions
  
+ Architecting integrations across enterprise applications and data platforms
  
+ Building AI/ML-enabled solution architectures
  
+ Preferred experience with:
  
+ IoT technologies and connected systems
  
+ Agile software development methodologies
  
+ DevSecOps practices and automation frameworks
  

  
**Nice to Have**
  

  
+ Hands-on experience with  **Databricks** ,  **Snowflake** , and  **Neo4j**
  
+ Experience designing  **Azure-native**  solutions
  
+ Familiarity with ML frameworks such as  **TensorFlow**  and  **PyTorch**
  
+ Knowledge of advanced analytics techniques including predictive modeling and AI-driven decision systems
  

  
**Competencies**
  

  
+ Balances stakeholders
  
+ Collaborates effectively
  
+ Communicates effectively
  
+ Decision quality
  
+ Persuades and influences
  
+ Strategic mindset
  
+ Change management
  
+ Values differences
  
+ Architecture system design
  
+ Solution design
  
+ Solution functional fit analysis
  
+ System solution architecture

title: Engine Field Service Technician - Level I
jobDescription:
**Job Summary:**
  

  
Under direct or close supervision, the Engine Field Service Technician – Level I performs preventive maintenance, basic diagnostics, and repair activities on Cummins engine products and related components at customer sites. The role supports customers through both field service and remote technical assistance by monitoring equipment health, responding to customer enquiries, coordinating service activities, and ensuring timely issue resolution. Working within established procedures, the technician develops technical expertise while delivering a high-quality customer experience and maintaining Cummins' standards for safety, quality, and operational excellence.
  

  
**Key Responsibilities:**
  

  
**Field Service & Technical Support**
  

  
+ Perform scheduled preventive maintenance and basic repair activities on Cummins engines and related components at customer sites.
  
+ Diagnose and troubleshoot basic mechanical and electrical issues using approved service procedures, electronic diagnostic tools, and specialized equipment.
  
+ Prepare required parts, tools, and equipment to complete service activities efficiently and safely.
  
+ Validate repairs by confirming successful resolution of customer concerns.
  
+ Escalate unresolved or complex technical issues to senior Field Service Technicians or Supervisors.
  

  
**Remote Monitoring & Customer Support**
  

  
+ Proactively monitor customer assets and engine health through remote monitoring systems to maximize equipment uptime.
  
+ Analyze live fault codes and provide immediate remote guidance or coordinate with dealers and field service teams for timely resolution.
  
+ Create service cases for critical faults, assign tasks to appropriate stakeholders, and track progress through to closure.
  
+ Provide technical support through multiple customer communication channels, including phone, email, chat, and remote monitoring platforms.
  
+ Respond to customer enquiries related to maintenance, product support, technical information, parts, warranty, and service availability.
  
+ Maintain regular communication with customers and ensure timely closure of service requests.
  

  
**Service Coordination & Documentation**
  

  
+ Complete service worksheets, inspection reports, timesheets, warranty claims, and technical documentation accurately using Cummins service management systems.
  
+ Document troubleshooting activities, customer interactions, and service history for accurate record keeping and warranty support.
  
+ Prepare operational reports and technical updates for internal stakeholders.
  
+ Coordinate with dealerships, field service teams, logistics partners, and cross-functional teams to ensure timely issue resolution.
  
+ Maintain accurate case records and update customer relationship management systems throughout the service lifecycle.
  

  
**Customer Experience**
  

  
+ Deliver courteous, professional, and customer-focused service during every interaction.
  
+ Provide customers with information regarding authorized service locations, genuine parts, engine records, training programs, and service support.
  
+ Follow up with customers to ensure satisfaction and communicate service progress until issue resolution.
  
+ Contribute ideas that improve customer experience and enhance service delivery processes.
  

  
**Health, Safety & Compliance**
  

  
+ Comply with all Cummins Health, Safety and Environmental (HSE) policies, procedures, and applicable regulations.
  
+ Promote safe work practices through proper use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), hazard identification, and incident reporting.
  
+ Ensure all maintenance and repair activities comply with Cummins quality standards and documented procedures.
  
+ Maintain assigned service vehicles, diagnostic equipment, and tools in a clean, safe, and operational condition.
  
+ Participate in technical, product, safety, and customer service training to continuously develop knowledge and skills.
  
+ Support business requirements through rotational shift coverage, including weekends and public holidays, where applicable.
  

  
+  **Competencies:**  Communicates Effectively
  
+ Customer Focus
  
+ Ensures Accountability
  
+ Plans and Aligns
  
+ Self-Development
  
+ Values Differences
  
+ Health and Safety Fundamentals
  
+ Diagnostics Application
  
+ Electrical Knowledge
  
+ Mechanical Knowledge
  
+ Electronic Service Tool Application
  
+ Product Repair and Maintenance
  
+ Service Documentation
  
+ Technical Escalation

+ Valid local driving license required.
  
+ May require licensing or eligibility to comply with export controls or sanctions regulations, where applicable. **Skills**
  
+ Basic engine diagnostics and troubleshooting

title: Data Scientist - Senior
jobDescription:
**Job Summary:**
  

  
Solves complex analytical problems using quantitative approaches through a combination of analytical, mathematical and technical skills. Researches, designs, implements and validates complex algorithms to analyze diverse sources of data to achieve targeted outcomes by leveraging complex statistical and predictive modeling concepts.
  

  
**Key Responsibilities:**
  

  
Participates in projects to support key objectives and business goals through the use of data science methodology. Leverages data science methodology to solve complex business problems. Creates multiple algorithms using complex statistical methodologies through the use of statistical programming languages and tools. Partners with domain experts to verify model capabilities. Partners with Solution Architect to enable appropriate data flow/data model, development using appropriate tools/technology, rapid prototyping and informs the design of analytical products. Partners with less experienced employees on data science tools and methodologies. Clearly articulates results, methodologies and learnings to stakeholder and peer group. Continuous development and advancement of the team through knowledge sharing and collaboration.
  

  
**Competencies:**
  
Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.
  

  
Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.
  

  
Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.
  

  
Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.
  

  
Tech savvy - Anticipating and adopting innovations in business-building digital and technology applications.
  

  
Data Mining - Extracts insights from data by identifying relationships and patterns through use of a suite of data exploration and data visualization techniques to understand the underlying structure of the data and enable sound conclusions upon model building.
  

  
Predictive Modeling - Develops analytical or machine learning models by using appropriate variable transformations, feature selection strategies, imputation strategies, class rebalancing, resampling strategies and quality control measures to generate predictive insights used in solving business questions.
  

  
Programming - Creates, writes and tests computer code, test scripts, and build scripts using algorithmic analysis and design, industry standards and tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance and compliance requirements.
  

  
Requirements Analysis - Evaluates relationships and interdependencies between requirements based upon their complexity and value to the business in order to determine feasibility and prioritization.
  

  
Statistical Modeling - Develops descriptive and explanatory statistical models, and simulations for regression, classification, outlier detection, anomaly detection, time series forecasting using knowledge of foundational statistics such as null hypotheses significance tests, regression models, generalized linear modeling, time series analysis, rank statistics, probability distribution fitting survival analysis, etc. to validate hypotheses for any given statistical or business question.
  

  
Problem Solving - Solves problems and may mentor others on effective problem solving by using a systematic analysis process by leveraging industry standard methodologies to create problem traceability and protect the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data-based solutions; identifies the systemic root causes and ensures actions to prevent problem reoccurrence are implemented.

title: Industrial Engineer - Senior
jobDescription:
**Job Summary:**
  

  
Designs, improves, and installs integrated manufacturing or administrative systems which use people, materials, information, equipment, and energy.

  

  
**Key Responsibilities:**
  

  
Leads work studies for new and current production lines. Leads standard work methods for new and current production lines. Leads the work for specific projects to create and implement all aspects of a manufacturing processes to ensure safety requirements, manufacturing goals, business goals, and product specifications are met. Leads by applying the knowledge or use of manufacturing principles and practices to improve manufacturing equipment and processes. Maintains the application of Cummins standards and develops manufacturing standards. Leads the communications with and influences key external stakeholders, business leaders, and functional members. Works with internal and external resources on specific project assignments. Leads the advanced knowledge of manufacturing principles and practices as they are applied to Cummins. Maintains relationships and coaches key stakeholders.
 **Competencies:**
  

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

  

  

Ergonomic Fundamentals - Understands ergonomic concepts by applying Cummins ergonomic standards, guidelines, controls and tools to reduce ergonomic risk to employees while at work.

  

  

Health and Safety Fundamentals - Champions and models proactive health and safety behaviors by identifying, reporting and participating in actions to improve health and safety in order to build an interdependent culture and contribute to an injury-free workplace.

  

  

Line Balancing - Evaluates work activities performed by individuals or machines to identify opportunities to optimize operating time and distributing of the work content to meet the changes in customer demands while continuing to optimize manufacturing processes.

  

  

Manufacturing Analysis Led Design - Uses digital tools to model and simulate manufacturing processes, equipment and performance to make data driven decisions before changes are made and to drive continuous improvements.

  

  

Manufacturing Knowledge - Demonstrates the knowledge of manufacturing by correctly implementing changes in current processes, equipment, and applications to meet the function's needs and contribute towards continuous improvement.

  

  

Process Layout - Creates and/or modifies an optimized manufacturing process by incorporating knowledge of equipment, human interfaces, sequences of production steps, and facilities requirements in order to reduce process time and waste.

  

  

Work Measurement - Quantifies and evaluates the elements of work that make up a process by breaking it down into detailed steps to identify and reduce waste, and redistribute work content to optimize process flows.

  

  

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

  

  

Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

  

  

Continuous Process Improvement - Recognizes areas in which a process can be improved by properly implementing process improvement and waste reduction methodologies to reduce process cost and improve quality in current manufacturing processes.

  

  

Drawing Interpretation - Integrates product design and manufacturing equipment engineering drawings to support the design and development of an optimal manufacturing process that meets product design specifications.

  

  

Industrial Engineering Knowledge - Integrates the pillars of industrial engineering techniques by applying a comprehensive and quantitative analysis to available data to be used as decision factors for the development or improvement of manufacturing processes to contribute to the most efficient process.

  

  
**Education, Licenses, Certifications:**
  

College, university, or degree in STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, Math) or related field, or equivalent experience required.

  

This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

  

  
**Experience:**
  

Intermediate level relevant work experience required.

  
**Job Description: Industrial Engineer Senior**
  

  
**Role Summary:**  We are seeking an Industrial Engineering professional with strong expertise in discrete manufacturing, industrial engineering, and data analytics. This role will transform manufacturing data into actionable insights, drive continuous improvement, and support the deployment of AI and analytics solutions across plant operations.
  

  
**Key Responsibilities**
  

  
+ Analyze data from digital manufacturing systems such as CMES, Connected Factory, Maximo, Q-DAS, OEE platforms, and other plant applications to identify improvement opportunities.
  
+ Partner with Operations, Manufacturing Engineering, Maintenance, Quality, and Supply Chain teams to understand process challenges and convert them into data-driven improvement projects.
  
+ Develop dashboards, analytics models, and performance insights to improve productivity, equipment utilization, quality, cost, and operational efficiency.
  
+ Support AI and machine learning use cases by providing manufacturing domain expertise, validating data logic, and helping enterprise AI teams translate plant requirements into practical solutions.
  
+ Perform data validation, root-cause analysis, and performance investigations using SQL, Python, Power BI, and other analytics tools.
  
+ Identify bottlenecks, waste, process variation, and reliability issues, then recommend practical actions to drive measurable business improvements.
  
+ Facilitate Industry 4.0 analytics workshops, train plant teams on analytics tools, and build capability for data-driven decision making.
  
+ Design and support Operations Control Tower concepts by integrating data from manufacturing, maintenance, quality, and ERP systems to provide a consolidated view of operations.
  

  
**Required Skills & Qualifications**
  

  
+ Bachelor’s degree in industrial engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, or a related field.
  
+ Strong understanding of discrete manufacturing processes, plant operations, lean manufacturing, industrial engineering methods, and continuous improvement practices.
  
+ Hands-on experience with manufacturing performance metrics such as OEE, throughput, downtime, cycle time, productivity, quality losses, and cost improvement.
  
+ Proficiency in data analytics tools and methods, including SQL, Python, Power BI, statistical analysis, and data visualization.
  
+ Ability to work with large operational data sets, validate data quality, identify trends, and convert analysis into business actions.
  
+ Experience collaborating with cross-functional plant teams and translating shop-floor challenges into analytics or AI use cases.
  
+ Strong communication, stakeholder management, problem-solving, and project execution skills.
  

  
**Preferred Experience**
  

  
+ Experience in Industry 4.0, smart manufacturing, connected factory, MES, ERP, or digital manufacturing platforms.
  
+ Exposure to AI, machine learning, predictive analytics, or advanced operations analytics in a manufacturing environment.
  
+ Experience leading value stream improvement, or data-driven productivity projects.
  
+ Ability to influence plant stakeholders and drive adoption of analytics-based improvement actions.
  

  
Looking at the data we gather from multiple systems, this position will add value in bringing meaningful insights for effective operations.

title: Supplier Quality Engineer
jobDescription:
The  **Supplier Quality Engineer**  supports supplier quality initiatives that enable the business to achieve its operational and strategic quality objectives. This role partners with suppliers and cross-functional teams to improve manufacturing processes, ensure compliance with quality standards, drive product and process validation, and resolve supplier quality issues. The position also supports supplier performance improvement through Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP), Production Part Approval Process (PPAP), supplier audits, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  

  
**Key Responsibilities**
  

  
+ Support supplier quality initiatives to improve supplier performance, product quality, and customer satisfaction.
  
+ Build and maintain effective relationships with suppliers and cross-functional stakeholders including Purchasing, Manufacturing, Engineering, Sourcing, and Quality teams.
  
+ Manage and review Global PPAP (Levels 1–4), including VPI PPAP submissions, ensuring compliance with customer and organizational requirements.
  
+ Audit PPAP documentation against established guidelines and provide disposition decisions (Approval, Interim Approval, or Rejection).
  
+ Coordinate with suppliers and Supplier Quality Engineers (SQEs) to ensure complete and accurate PPAP documentation is uploaded into CQMS/EQMS.
  
+ Collaborate with suppliers, sourcing managers, and change managers to resolve rejected or interim PPAP submissions and ensure timely closure.
  
+ Monitor interim PPAP approvals and drive timely completion before expiration.
  
+ Maintain PPAP turnaround time (TAT) targets and ensure timely disposition of submissions.
  
+ Participate in supplier manufacturing process evaluations using APQP methodologies and AIAG core quality tools.
  
+ Conduct or support supplier process audits and contribute to continuous improvement of supplier manufacturing processes.
  
+ Support investigation of supplier quality issues by performing root cause analysis, implementing corrective actions, and verifying their effectiveness.
  
+ Apply Lean, Six Sigma, and continuous improvement methodologies to reduce defects and improve supplier capability.
  
+ Participate in supplier quality planning, quality performance reviews, and supplier development initiatives.
  
+ Ensure supplier compliance with quality management systems, engineering specifications, and regulatory requirements.
  
+ Support product reliability and manufacturing process validation activities throughout product development and production.
  

  
**Skills and Competencies**
  

  
+ Supplier Quality Management
  
+ Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP)
  
+ Production Part Approval Process (PPAP)
  
+ AIAG Core Tools (DFMEA, PFMEA, Control Plan, SPC, MSA, PPAP)
  
+ Quality Management Systems (ISO 9001:2015, IATF 16949)
  
+ Supplier Auditing and Process Assessment
  
+ Root Cause Analysis and Corrective Action (8D, 5 Why, Fishbone)
  
+ Manufacturing Process Design and Validation
  
+ Statistical Analysis and Process Capability
  
+ Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerancing (GD&T)
  
+ Engineering Drawing Interpretation
  
+ Supplier Performance Improvement
  
+ Product Reliability and Process Validation
  
+ Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma methodologies
  
+ Problem-solving and analytical skills
  
+ Strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management
  
+ Customer-focused approach with the ability to influence cross-functional teams
  
+ Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet turnaround time targets
  

  
**Experience**
  

  
+ Experience in supplier quality, manufacturing quality, quality engineering, or a related engineering function is preferred.

title: Product Engineering Specialist
jobDescription:
**Job Summary:**
  

  
This product focused position performs established technical tasks at the sub-system and/or component level for current and future products within a given business unit or corporate area. This involves work across many steps in the product life cycle. Because of the product centered nature of this position, they are very often a central point of coordination and decision making between product line engineers, customer teams, systems engineers, purchasing, suppliers and manufacturing.

  

  
**Key Responsibilities:**
  

  
Obtains input from stakeholders such as technical managers, project leaders, other product and manufacturing engineers and supplier partners to deliver information and recommendations that lead to quality product decisions. Applies academic knowledge and existing experience to take action and make decisions that progress projects forward without sacrificing project quality expectations. Examples of these decisions include day to day project details, analysis or test work instruction details, coordination across discipline areas that are necessary to make quality progress. Applies and improves processes such as Engineering Standard Work (ESW), iDFMEA, Failure Incident Review Group (FIRG) and tools such as 7-step problem solving, design review checklist and other specialized tools required to support the processes and enable high quality decision making. Provides independent leadership of smaller business impact projects or ownership of complex components, products, systems or services with greater elements of ambiguity over the senior or lead engineer level and with full accountability to the project team. Delivers independent execution of established and emerging work processes and systems, while still developing technology or product knowledge. Leads the development and improvement of work processes and systems across a functional discipline area within a business unit site. Coordinates and directs work amongst technicians and temporary student employees, assists in the transfer of knowledge to lesser experienced engineers through either indirect (scope of influence) or direct management of a small, local group of engineers. Provides support and guidance to influence technical direction within a project team and continues to develop proficiency in the competency areas critical to success in the role. Operates as a recognized specialist in a discipline or product area within the immediate team.
 **Competencies:**
  

Product Development Execution, Monitoring and Control - Plans, schedules, coordinates and executes the activities involved in developing a product to a respectively aligned hierarchy of requirements and technical profiles; monitors and communicates across functional boundaries to meet project resource and quality expectations; ensures product capability meets or exceeds expectations and takes mitigating actions when project risks are higher than expected; understands the full product life cycle process and stakeholders.

  

  

Product Failure Mode Avoidance - Mitigates potential product failure modes, by identifying interfaces, functions, functional requirements, interactions, control factors, noise factors, and prioritized potential failure modes and potential failure causes for the system of interest to effectively and efficiently improve the reliability of Cummins’ products.

  

  

Product Function Modeling, Simulation and Analysis - Impacts product design decisions through the utilization and/or interpretation of computational tools and methods that predict the capability of a product's function relative to its system, sub-system and/or component level requirements.

  

  

Product Interface Management and Integration - Identifies and analyzes the interfaces and interactions across system boundaries by specifying the requirements and limits to ensure that the product meets requirements; controls the interactions across the system element boundaries by making sure that they remain within specified limits; integrates system elements by creating an integration plan, including identification of method and timing for each activity to make it easier to find, isolate, diagnose, and correct.

  

  

Product Problem Solving - Solves product problems using a process that protects the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data-based solutions; and identifies the systemic root causes and recommended actions to prevent problem reoccurrence.

  

  

Product Verification and Validation Management - Develops product systems validation plans from a variety of inputs to identify failure modes, while managing product risk and relative priority; negotiates product requirements against capability to guide project scope; evaluates analytical, simulation and physical test results to verify product capability and validate requirements; assesses legacy versus proposed system solution capabilities and produces recommendations with technical documentation to support product decisions.

  

  

System Requirements Engineering  - Uses appropriate methods and tools to translate stakeholder needs into verifiable requirements to which designs are developed; establishes acceptance criteria for the system of interest through analysis, allocation and negotiation; tracks the status of requirements throughout the system lifecycle; assesses the impact of changes to system requirements on project scope, schedule, and resources; creates and maintains information linkages to related artifacts.

  

  

Technical Documentation - Documents information based on knowledge gained as part of technical function activities; communicates to stakeholders with the goal of enabling improved technical productivity and effective knowledge transfer to others who were not originally part of the initial learning.

  

  

Technical Documentation - Documents information based on knowledge gained as part of technical function activities; communicates to stakeholders with the goal of enabling improved technical productivity and effective knowledge transfer to others who were not originally part of the initial learning.

  

  

Builds networks - Effectively building formal and informal relationship networks inside and outside the organization.

  

  

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

  

  

Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.

  

  

Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.

  

  

Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.

  

  

Resourcefulness - Securing and deploying resources effectively and efficiently.

  

  

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

  

  

Design and Application of Open/Closed Loop Controls - Specifies software features that interact with mechanical, hydraulic, chemical and electronic systems to deliver desired system states; specifies control system architectures which include appropriate measurements, correct actuation, and algorithms for Cummins' products; configures and/or understands open/closed loop feedback controls features and the system interactions between hardware and software in Cummins' products.

  

  

Product Configuration and Change Management - Establishes a baseline of identified product artifacts to be placed under configuration management; releases, tracks, controls and communicates changes from concept to obsolescence often through work requests; establishes and maintains the integrity of the product artifact baselines.

  

  

Mechanical Design of Mechanical Systems - Acquires and applies an in-depth understanding of mechanical systems through working knowledge that guides a designer’s ability to create innovative and sound design concepts to meet Cummins and customer expectations; designs for requirements of all lifecycle stages by considering the customer requirements in different operating environments to ensure a robust system.

  

  

Mechanical Design Specification - Creates complete specifications in the form of solid models, configured engineering bill of materials and detailed drawings that cross-functionally communicate the information required to manufacture and inspect a product per its design intent; considers national, international, industry, and Cummins’ standards that accurately and concisely define the part specification.

  

  
**Education, Licenses, Certifications:**
  

College, university, or equivalent Bachelor's degree in Engineering or appropriate STEM field is required.

  

  

Post-graduate (Master's) degree relevant to this discipline area may be required for select roles.

  

  

This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

  

  
**Experience:**
  

Prior Senior or Lead Engineer equivalent work experience in a relevant discipline area is required with a demonstrated track record of technical problem solving and quality decision making. Knowledge of MS Office tools is preferred.

  
**Skills:**
  

  
+ Strong understanding of ADS components like Doser, Mixers and/or fuel systems components.
  
+ Proficiency in 3D modeling tools (Creo) and engineering drawing standards (GD&T).
  
+ Knowledge of design tools and methodologies (DFMEA, DFM, DFA, DV&V).
  
+ Familiarity with Cummins processes (VPI, PPT, CPS) and tools (Windchill, RV&S).
  
+ Ability to interpret simulation results (structural and flow analysis).
  
+ Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
  
+ Effective communication and collaboration abilities.
  
+ Working knowledge of manufacturing processes and product validation techniques.
  

  
**Experience:**
  

  
+ 5+ years of experience in CES products or Fuel Systems product lines
  
+ 8–10 years of product design and development experience preferred.
  
+ Experience in cross-functional design reviews and product lifecycle processes.

title: Supply Chain Coordinator - Level III
jobDescription:

+ Prepare and present analytical reports and recommendations to support planning decisions and business reviews.
  
+ Participate in continuous improvement initiatives focused on planning processes, quality, inventory management, material flow, and operational excellence.

title: Supply Chain Coordinator - Level III
jobDescription:
The Supply Chain Coordinator – Level III is responsible for planning, coordinating, and optimizing end-to-end supply chain operations by balancing customer demand, supply availability, and inventory levels. Working with minimal supervision, this role uses statistical analysis, planning systems, and cross-functional collaboration to develop and maintain accurate demand, supply, and inventory plans. The position drives supply chain stability, supports operational excellence, and ensures customer requirements are met through effective planning, inventory optimization, and continuous process improvement.
  

  
**Key Responsibilities**
  

  
+ Develop, maintain, and execute demand, supply, and inventory plans that align customer requirements with business objectives.
  
+ Analyze demand and supply trends, identify risks and constraints, and proactively recommend corrective actions to maintain supply chain stability.
  
+ Perform supply and demand analysis, highlighting opportunities and potential risks across short- and long-term planning horizons.
  
+ Monitor inventory performance and optimize planning parameters, including minimum/maximum inventory levels, reorder points, safety stock, and planning signals.
  
+ Support and apply Plan for Every Part (PFEP) principles to improve material flow, inventory optimization, and overall supply chain efficiency.
  
+ Execute planning parameter simulations, evaluate impacts on key performance indicators (KPIs), and provide recommendations based on analytical results.
  
+ Monitor planning system exception messages, abnormal demand signals, and inventory alerts, performing root cause analysis and implementing approved planning adjustments.
  
+ Enter and maintain approved forecast changes to ensure alignment between aggregate and detailed demand plans.
  
+ Collaborate with procurement, manufacturing, logistics, suppliers, customer service, and other cross-functional teams to ensure effective execution of supply plans.
  
+ Build and maintain productive relationships with external suppliers to support material availability and supply continuity.
  
+ Utilize materials planning systems and analytical tools to support decision-making, reporting, and process improvements.
  
+ Generate reports, analyze supply chain KPIs, and communicate performance trends and improvement opportunities to stakeholders.
  
+ Participate in continuous improvement initiatives focused on quality, safety, material flow, inventory optimization, and operational excellence.
  
+ Ensure compliance with Cummins Health, Safety & Environmental (HSE) policies, quality standards, and applicable regulatory requirements.

title: Vulnerability Management Product Cyber Specialist
jobDescription:
**Job Summary**
  

  
Forensic Analysis & Offensive Security for Product Cybersecurity This role supports shift left forensic and offensive security evaluations for embedded and connected products across on highway and off highway platforms. The role is focused on hands on technical execution, including early vulnerability discovery, exploit feasibility analysis, architecture reviews, reverse engineering, and pre certification penetration testing, to provide actionable technical findings ahead of external certification testing. This role does not own security capability strategy, tooling ownership, or organizational maturity and does not replace external penetration testing or certification mandated evaluations.
  

  
**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**
  

  
+ Vulnerability Scanning & Analysis
  
+  Perform firmware, binary, and configuration vulnerability scanning, side channel attacks on embedded products.
  
+ Identify known weaknesses such as insecure configurations, outdated components, and cryptographic issues.
  
+  Assess vulnerabilities based on practical exploitability and product context, in addition to standard severity scoring.
  
+ Document findings clearly with technical evidence and reproducible observations. B. Product & ECU Penetration Testing
  
+  Execute pre certification penetration testing activities early in the product lifecycle.
  
+ Perform attacker perspective testing to identify realistic product weaknesses prior to engagement with external labs.
  
+ Conduct hands on testing using defined test setups for: o ECU level penetration testing o System level penetration testing o CAN / UDS / J1939 / Ethernet / MODBUS and related protocol fuzzing
  
+ Provide test results, observations, and technical inputs that complement external penetration testing efforts.
  
+  Architecture & Threat Assessments
  
+ Perform shift left architecture reviews focused on identifying implementation weaknesses related to, Trust boundaries o Cryptographic usage and key handling o Secure boot and firmware integrity o OTA mechanisms o Secure communication paths
  
+ Correlate architectural weaknesses with observed attack paths and test results from internal assessments.
  
+ Provide specific, actionable technical recommendations to improve product robustness prior to external testing.
  
+ Reverse Engineering & Firmware Analysis
  
+  Extract firmware using available interfaces such as JTAG/SWD, memory access techniques, and OTA packages.
  
+  Perform static and dynamic binary analysis using reverse engineering tools.
  
+  Support protocol analysis, secure boot evaluation, and proof of concept exploit development where required to validate findings.

title: IT Support Associate - Level III
jobDescription:
The IT Support Associate – Level III (Manufacturing IT) works independently with limited supervision to provide advanced operational and production IT support across Cummins Manufacturing locations in the India region. This role ensures the effectiveness, efficiency, accuracy, and availability of IT systems and end-user devices. The associate manages incidents and service requests, supports manufacturing hardware, servers, and applications, coordinates with vendors, mentors junior associates, and drives continuous improvement initiatives while collaborating across teams and regions.
  

  
**Key Responsibilities**   **Incident Management & End-User Support**
  

  
+ Provide end-user IT support for manufacturing systems across Cummins manufacturing locations in India.
  
+ Create, track, monitor, and resolve incidents using the Incident Management system until closure.
  
+ Respond to user support requests and engage end users to understand and diagnose issues.
  
+ Troubleshoot hardware, software, compliance tools (Antivirus, Tanium, SOTI, Macrium, WSUS), and first-level network issues.
  
+ Provide remote or on-site support based on issue severity and operational needs.
  
+ Follow up with end users to confirm resolution and satisfaction prior to closing incidents.
  
+ Analyze incident trends and perform root cause analysis for recurring issues.
  

  
**Service Request Management & Device Lifecycle**
  

  
+ Manage deployment, configuration, re-assignment, and surrender of Cummins Manufacturing Devices (CMDs).
  
+ Format and configure new manufacturing devices per approved service requests.
  
+ Install and configure compliance and security tools such as AV, Tanium, WSUS, and Macrium.
  
+ Coordinate device re-assignment activities, ensuring data backup, formatting, and reconfiguration.
  
+ Inspect surrendered devices for damage and completeness before formatting.
  
+ Support hardware shipment activities including depot management, inventory updates, packing, NPDN creation, docket booking, e-waybill generation, and coordination with vendors and end users.
  

  
**Server & Major Incident Support**
  

  
+ Support server hardware and hosted manufacturing applications.
  
+ Participate in major incident management and resolution activities.
  
+ Coordinate and guide remote teams during server-related troubleshooting efforts.
  

  
**General IT Support & Continuous Improvement**
  

  
+ Perform IT production support and independently resolve hardware and application issues.
  
+ Install, configure, and disposition IT hardware and applications according to standards.
  
+ Create and maintain technical documentation, SOPs, and support processes.
  
+ Train and mentor less experienced IT Support Associates on tools, processes, and best practices.
  
+ Work with users to understand requirements and recommend appropriate hardware solutions.
  
+ Champion Six Sigma methodologies and continuous improvement initiatives.
  
+ Identify and implement service improvement opportunities.
  
+ Support additional IT responsibilities and projects as assigned.
  

  
**Skills & Experience**
  

  
+ Minimum 3 years of hands-on IT support experience in a manufacturing environment.
  
+ Experience supporting industrial-grade hardware such as Advantech, Zebra, or similar devices.
  
+ Exposure to manufacturing applications such as Apriso, QDAS, or equivalent is preferred.
  
+ Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  
+ Experience using Incident Management systems for tracking and reporting.
  
+ Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.
  
+ Experience managing vendors and coordinating across cross-functional teams.
  
+ Ability to work independently and lead small projects.
  
+ Knowledge of IT lifecycle management and procurement processes.
  

  
**Competencies – Explanation**
  

  
+  **Action Oriented:**  Proactively takes ownership of issues, responds with urgency, and drives tasks to completion without waiting for direction.
  
+  **Balances Stakeholders:**  Effectively manages and aligns the needs of end users, manufacturing teams, vendors, and IT leadership.
  
+  **Business Insight:**  Understands manufacturing operations and applies IT knowledge to support business goals and productivity.
